schema.entries: Append only array. Order is chronological. Entries are never edited or removed.

entries.summary: Read the full specification set, verified the live state of vps-lama, and verified every dependency against current documentation so no deprecated API is used.

decisions.decision: Use go 1.26.0 with toolchain go1.27.4 in go.mod. Host VPS Go 1.22.2 cannot build crypto/hkdf code, so Linux binaries are cross compiled on the Windows workstation.
decisions.rationale: crypto/hkdf was added after Go 1.22 and the VPS toolchain is stale. Cross compilation with CGO_ENABLED=0 removes the VPS toolchain from the critical path.

decisions.decision: Use the standard library crypto/hkdf.Key and drop golang.org/x/crypto/hkdf.
decisions.rationale: The x repository package is now a thin wrapper around the standard library implementation. A local compile probe on Go 1.26 confirmed the standard library API returns a 32 byte key without error.

decisions.decision: Use github.com/go-webauthn/webauthn v0.18.2 instead of a hand rolled assertion verifier.
decisions.rationale: The library implements WebAuthn Level 3, gives BeginRegistration, FinishRegistration, BeginLogin, FinishLogin, and returns a JSON serialisable SessionData plus a Credential value.

decisions.decision: Vendor @tailwindcss/browser@4.3.5 and alpinejs@3.17.5 into web/vendor at setup time and embed them with embed.FS.
decisions.rationale: cdn.tailwindcss.com serves Tailwind v3. cdnjs does not host the Tailwind v4 browser bundle. Vendoring keeps the strict default-src self content security policy, works offline, and removes demo day CDN risk.

decisions.decision: Add webauthn_credentials, web_sessions, and auth_challenges tables beyond the four tables in context/001.
decisions.rationale: go-webauthn requires a credential list per user and a persisted SessionData between ceremonies. The USB dongle challenge needs a short lived server side record with expiry.

decisions.decision: Cross compile static binaries, transfer them with scp, and let a systemd unit own the Podman pod lifecycle. Build container images locally and load them remotely.
decisions.rationale: The VPS has a stale Go toolchain, 26 GB free disk, and rootful Podman 4.9.3 with podman.socket active. Building on the host would pull a large Go image and burn disk.

decisions.decision: Document that the public hostname for port 8095 must be added in the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard.
decisions.rationale: cloudflared-claw.service runs in token mode with no on disk config.yml, so the tunnel ingress rules cannot be edited locally.

decisions.decision: Run MedVault under a new unprivileged account medvault instead of the existing liteclaw account. Provision it with deploy/setup-user.sh and connect through a new SSH alias medvault-vps.
decisions.rationale: Separates application blast radius from the pre-existing admin account. The account is password locked, has linger enabled, and receives scoped sudo rather than NOPASSWD ALL. The provisioning script is idempotent and never truncates existing users, unit files, or .env content.

entries.summary: Replaced the copied skill with a MedVault-only runbook, provisioned a dedicated medvault service account on the VPS, and built the configuration, database, telemetry, crypto, biometric dHash, steganography, and ledger packages test first.

decisions.decision: Every backend package is written test first. The test file is created and run to observe a genuine failure before the implementation exists.
decisions.rationale: The user explicitly required TDD for backend work. Observed red states were: stego missing symbols, then a readBits offset bug and a tamper test positioned outside the payload; biometric two wrong expectations in the test itself.

decisions.decision: Keep the go directive at go 1.26.0 with no toolchain line.
decisions.rationale: Local toolchain is go1.26.0. Pinning a toolchain directive would force a download on every build. crypto/hkdf compiles fine at 1.26.

decisions.decision: web/vendor/tailwind-browser.min.js (286994 bytes) and web/vendor/alpine.min.js (55935 bytes) are fetched by deploy/fetch-assets.ps1 and deploy/fetch-assets.sh, checksummed into web/vendor/CHECKSUMS.txt.
decisions.rationale: Enables a default-src self content security policy and removes third party origins from the demo path.

decisions.decision: Lab file vault seals 64 KiB chunks with ChaCha20-Poly1305 and a big endian counter nonce. The record identity is bound as additional data on the first chunk only.
decisions.rationale: Keeps peak memory bounded on a 96 MB container while still authenticating every chunk.

entries.summary: Built the HTTP layer, the four commands, the five tab browser UI, and the full deployment toolchain test first, then deployed the pod to the VPS and verified the whole medical record flow against the live stack with a real dongle signature and a real validator countersignature.

decisions.decision: Path based versioning. Every business route lives under /api/v1. Only /healthz stays unversioned, and the validator gateway exposes /internal/v1/validate.
decisions.rationale: The user chose path versioning over header versioning. Keeping health probes unversioned lets container health checks and the reverse proxy stay stable across future API generations.

decisions.decision: POST /api/v1/records builds the block, stashes the pending proposal under a short lived token, and returns the exact tx_payload. The browser signs that payload with the dongle key through WebCrypto Ed25519 and posts it to /api/v1/records/seal, which appends the block.
decisions.rationale: The private seed never leaves the dongle, yet the signature must cover the server built block. Splitting the request lets the browser sign after the server has fixed the payload, without a round trip through any server side private key.

decisions.decision: The browser imports the raw 32 byte seed by prefixing the fixed PKCS8 header 302e020100300506032b657004220420 before calling crypto.subtle.importKey.
decisions.rationale: WebCrypto has no raw Ed25519 seed import. The DER prefix turns a raw seed into a valid PKCS8 document, which keeps the on disk dongle format compact and portable.

decisions.decision: The genesis block is derived by the app from crypto.DeriveKey with the master root secret, the info string medvault-audit-genesis-v1, and the per user salt genesis:<username>.
decisions.rationale: The dongle only certifies clinical actions, so it cannot sign a genesis block. Deriving it from the master secret keeps the chain anchored without inventing a second private key.

decisions.decision: MEDVAULT_VALIDATOR_PRIVKEY_HEX carries a 32 byte Ed25519 seed, not the 64 byte expanded private key, and matches NewSignerFromSeed and the validator-keygen output.
decisions.rationale: The configuration validates the length at startup, so a mismatch fails fast instead of silently signing with the wrong key.

decisions.decision: Binaries are cross compiled on Windows with CGO_ENABLED=0, copied to /home/medvault/bin, and the images are built on the VPS from Containerfile.app and Containerfile.validator. The systemd unit owns the pod lifecycle.
decisions.rationale: The host Go toolchain is 1.22.2 and cannot build crypto/hkdf code. Building images on the VPS avoids shipping a container runtime dependency to the workstation and keeps the images native to the target architecture.

decisions.decision: The scoped sudoers entry now allows systemctl is-enabled, enable, and disable for medvault-pod.service, and remote-deploy.sh exits non zero if enable fails.
decisions.rationale: The first deployment left the unit disabled, so the pod would not have returned after a reboot, and the deploy script hid the failure with a trailing true. Failing loudly makes the gap impossible to miss.
